system.description:
Lore: Relic Chain

Dwarven-made and light as cloth, it never announces the wearer the way steel does. It has the following Powers:

  • Featherweight: Counts as Chain armor, but never imposes Hinder on Checks to move quietly and has no Might requirement.

Value: 1000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
